name: gpclient
title: GlobalProtect VPN
description: Menu bar controls for reconnecting, disconnecting, and switching gateways
author: junjiec

commands.name: menu-bar
commands.title: VPN Menu Bar
commands.subtitle: gpclient
commands.description: Show VPN status and connect, disconnect, or switch gateway from the menu bar

commands.name: first-login
commands.title: Sign In with SSO
commands.subtitle: gpclient
commands.description: Open the browser for SSO, then connect and save the cookie cache. Needed once per gateway session (about weekly), not only the first time.

commands.name: reconnect
commands.title: Reconnect VPN
commands.subtitle: gpclient
commands.description: Reconnect using the cached portal cookie

commands.name: split-tunnel
commands.title: Configure Split Tunnel
commands.subtitle: gpclient
commands.description: Edit the vpn-slice DNS domains, routed subnets, and hosts as separate lists

commands.name: live-progress
commands.title: VPN Live Progress
commands.subtitle: gpclient
commands.description: Step list that auto-refreshes. The menu bar dropdown cannot update while it is open.

preferences.name: gateway
preferences.title: Default gateway
preferences.description: Gateway used by Reconnect. Other gateways come from the portal after the first successful connect.

preferences.name: gateways
preferences.title: Other gateways
preferences.description: Comma-separated hostnames shown under Switch Gateway
